notes:
An update ahead of the massive "Legends Festival" campaign!

New Trending and Recommended functions added to make it easier to form stronger parties!

・Trending allows you to copy Characters and Equipment used by top players! Check out popular party formations!

・Recommended displays characters frequently used together with your Leader! Form a party around characters you want to use!

Plus, new functions will be added for an all-new Event! Be sure to keep your eyes peeled!
